Narrative Summary
In September 2026, WPD handled 398 calls for service. Excluding Security Checks, Whittier accounted for 100
and Girdwood 105 calls. Serious incidents stood out, including Alarm (5), MVA/Accident (5), Welfare Check (3),
Assault (2). Additionally, there were 1 death-related call this month (Cruise Ship). Jurisdictional mix: Whittier
36.7%, Girdwood 61.1%, Other 2.3%.

Bullet-Point Summary
•   Whittier: 146 calls. Top types: Traffic (55), EMS/Fire (7), Parking Problem (5).
•   Girdwood: 243 calls. Top types: Traffic (61), Disturbance (9), Agency Assist (4).
•   Other: 9 calls. Top types: Unspecified in CAD (3), Traffic (2), EMS/Fire (1).
